desc: Prove that the answer for \(A_i\) is the largest divisor \(d\) of \(A_i\) whose global multiple-count is at least \(K\).
Implement a frequency array and sieve loop to compute the count of array elements divisible by every divisor.
Implement ascending feasible-divisor propagation so each numeric value receives its largest feasible divisor.
Ensure performance is suitable for \(N\le 1.2\times10^6\) and values up to \(10^6\), including buffered stdin/stdout.
Verify edge cases: \(K=1\), \(K=N\), duplicates, and value 1.
Run all provided sample tests and report the verdict.
